verified_facts.hardware_gate: 3 GiB available RAM is a preflight start threshold, not a completion guarantee.

kinematic_120_features.reason: Time-weighted speed regimes, distance fractions, acceleration, ordered turns, and day/night features require suitable point-level fields/timing. The reviewed input has only per-vessel summaries.
specific_definition_gaps: The listed speed bands leave 5-8 kt unassigned.
Boundary inclusivity, units/source field, missing/invalid readings, and time/distance weighting are unspecified.
ROT kurtosis and heading-change Shannon entropy are distinct statistics and need separate definitions.
Turn features need heading wrap, sampling, bins, and minimum sequence rules.
Day/night requires a time basis, location/solar-time rule, and activity rule.
A closed 120-feature registry, missingness policy, and final model input schema are absent.
kinematic_120_features.source_timestamp_scope: No claim that every original raw source lacks timestamps; only that the reviewed tensors do not supply the point tracks and the raw rows were not inspected.

m4_head.observed: Final registered decoder Linear is 1024-to-10, weight [10,1024]; four task probabilities are produced after class mapping.
required_before_training: verify gradients on synthetic or allowed FIT-only data under a separate plan

lora_and_context.baseline: Historical runner used full fold FIT context; fold 0 has 3144 FIT rows.
limits: A 16-shot context is not equivalent to the full FIT context.
Define prototype class allocation and centroid/boundary selection; fit any selection statistics within training folds only.
Do not combine head-only, LoRA, and 16-shot selection in a first comparison.

stacking_and_calibration.current_evidence: No new CatBoost or M4 base predictions, meta OOF predictions, or calibration results in reviewed rounds.
definition_gaps: For 12 dimensions, specify that five LightGBM seeds are aggregated to one four-class vector, or revise the dimension count.
PDF conflicts between probability and logit inputs; choose one representation and class order.
Fit meta learner and calibrator without each evaluation fold labels; avoid reusing INNER for model selection, meta fitting, and calibration.
Classwise isotonic may not preserve row sums; define normalization, small-class support, calibration split, and ECE bins.
stacking_and_calibration.evaluation: Repeatedly observed development OUTER is not an independent final estimate; preserve holdout/Test2025 boundary until protocol is frozen.

short_observation_encoder.reason: Current tensors lack time-ordered segment input and reviewed labels are vessel-level. The 1-7 day bucket is an observation-day subgroup, not segment ground truth or necessarily actual operating time.
required: segment labels or declared weak-label objective

recommended_gates: Export/hash-check original ordered FIT and INNER arrays; run the bounded full-FIT CPU original-output replay before any training.
Resolve the 10-way decoder versus four-class task-head mapping before M4.
Evaluate head-only, LoRA, and 16-shot context as separate changes.
Require authorized point data, timestamps, feature formulas, and label unit before kinematic or segment work.
Build stacking/calibration with nested vessel-grouped cross-fitting and no evaluation-fold labels.
Use representative memory measurements; retain preflight and own-child stop gates without treating them as guarantees.
